name: flamewake_phoenix_ferocious_returns_it_and_it_attacks
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Flying, haste. This creature attacks each combat if able. Ferocious — At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, you may pay {R}. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Flamewake Phoenix is in seat 0's graveyard and seat 0 controls a 4/4 Ogre and one Mountain. At the beginning of combat seat 0 takes the offer and pays {R} with the Mountain: the Phoenix returns under seat 0's control, and with haste it must attack: it is declared without an attack answer (the Ogre is told to stay home) and deals 2.
